heading: Need help now?
body:
If you're hurting right now, you don't have to carry it alone, and you don't have to have the right words. Reaching out for help is not a lack of faith. It's often the next faithful step.

If you're in danger, or you're having thoughts of not wanting to live, please reach out now. Then tell a pastor, a doctor, a counselor, or a trusted believer today. God is near to you, and so are people who want to help.

lines.label: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
lines.detail: Call or text 988 (U.S.), any time, day or night.

lines.label: National Domestic Violence Hotline
lines.detail: If someone is hurting you, call 1-800-799-7233.

encourage: You can also reach out to a pastor, a doctor, or a counselor. Getting help is wisdom, not weakness.
